scoring_justification: Absolute energies depend on the DFT implementation and basis set; relative signs (quartet vs doublet) and trend peaks (stability maxima at n=2 and n=5) are robust across equivalent methods and are the paper's core claims.

schema.description: One object per cluster size n=1 to 6.

outputs.description: Ground-state spin multiplicity per cluster size, with an indication that all vibrational frequencies are positive. The structural audit verifies the sign of the doublet-quartet energy difference and that all frequencies are positive.

schema.description: One object per cluster size n=1 to 6.

outputs.description: Size-dependent binding energy per atom. The structural audit checks for consistency with expected stability trends.

schema.description: One object per cluster size n=1 to 6.

outputs.description: Fragmentation energies for two channels. The structural audit checks for consistency with expected stability trends.

output_contract.notes: All outputs are arrays ordered by n=1 to 6. The absolute numerical values are not required to match the paper exactly; the structural audit checks relative ordering and peak locations. The agent must use the same DFT method (B3LYP) and a comparable all-electron basis set.
